body:
Gold Coin 2023-2024 St. Patrick's Event

Description

"This must be worth a load of money! Happy Saint Patrick's Day!"

Gold Coin was part of the 2023, 2024, and 2025 St. Patrick's Event and could be found in Pots of Gold. You can interact with it and flip it. Coins can also be sold at Jer's Junkyard (Part of the Roblox game Oaklands) or the Resource Hub for a random price.
